description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git rev-list --bisect' functionality. It sets up test cases, defines test sequences, and checks the output of git commands related to bisecting revisions in a git repository.

methods.name: test_bisection_diff
methods.description: A function that performs a bisection test comparing the size of revision lists generated by git rev-list with different options, checking if the bisection reduces the list size within a specified maximum difference.

methods.name: test_sequence
methods.description: A function that executes a series of test cases to verify the behavior of 'git rev-list --bisect' under various scenarios, including identifying the bad commit via binary search logic.
